name: CMOS two-bit magnitude comparator
description: Fifty native SKY130 core MOS devices implement unsigned two-bit LT/EQ/GT decisions using TG XNOR bit comparisons and static NAND trees. The MSB decides first; the LSB decides on a tie. Three 100 fF loads are explicit. At 1.8 V and 27 C, the website SKY130A continuous TT models pass all 16 input pairs and all three flags (48 checks). The drawing and transistor pin order are preserved. This is nominal functional verification; hazards, delay, mismatch and PVT are not qualified.
